meta.aggregate_only: All values are aggregate counts of passengers/visits; no individual-level data.

fields.pax_12m: T-100 segment passengers arriving (deplaned) at airport, all carriers, scheduled+charter, domestic+international origins, last 12 months
fields.seasonality: share of last-12-month arrivals by calendar month, index 0 = January
fields.od_share: DB1B coupon pax arriving here whose trip breaks here (destination/stopover) / all coupon pax arriving here; 1-od_share = connecting
fields.visitor_share: as od_share but also excluding itineraries that started at this airport (residents returning home) = inbound visitors
fields.arrival_hour_share: share of reporting-carrier arrivals by LOCAL hour 0-23 (actual arrival time; scheduled if cancelled/diverted)
fields.checkin_window: shortest contiguous local-hour span holding >=50% of arrivals (end exclusive) + peak hour
fields.county.visitor_pax_12m_within_60km: sum over airports within 60 km (straight line from county centroid) of pax_12m * visitor_share (median share if missing); airports are counted for every county in range (not apportioned)
fields.county.intl_arrivals_state: NTTO I-94 overseas + Mexico (air/sea) visitor arrivals with first intended address in county's state, 12 months (Canada not included)
fields.county.nps_visits_80km: NPS recreation visits, 12 months, to park units whose boundary lies within 80 km of county centroid
fields.county.seasonality: visitor-pax-weighted month-of-year share of the county's airports (index 0 = Jan)
